title: xtpd: the XTP network service daemon (design)
purpose: Design continuity for xtpd, the one multi-threaded XTP network service daemon per node: registrations, service requests, peerages, hooks, firewall linkage, lifecycle once, degradation and the local emergency text files. Architecture: Tom Dyer. Written by: Claude (Opus 5.5), 24 November 2026. Design only: nothing built or field-tested.
